name: Vag
title: Cotton
description: Buzz-cut brawler in a cream v-neck and navy cargos. Super dumps cotton on the floor — he has to run it down. Each boll heals him and chips the other guy.
source_description: Male fighter, athletic build, buzz cut, cream v-neck t-shirt, navy cargo shorts, white sneakers no logo, standing stance.
special_desc: A forward burst across the lane, like he is late for the next boll.
ultimate_desc: Cotton hits the floor. Pick each boll up: you heal, they lose health.
